newsitem.title: USA: Clinton optimistic on reaching budget deal.
newsitem.headline: Clinton optimistic on reaching budget deal.

text.p: President Clinton is optimistic that he will reach a budget agreement with Congressional leaders, a White House spokesman said.

"The president is optimistic on a budget deal ... but there's no deal at this point," White House spokesman Joe Lockhart told reporters on board Air Force One shortly before Clinton arrived in Las Vegas.
He said that Clinton intended to discuss the budget negotiations in an address to the National Governors Association.
"He's going to talk in general that we've made progress," Lockhart said.
